user.title: Choose Connection Mode
user.description: Select how you want to connect to Hydro-Québec

data_description.auth_mode: Portal mode: log in for full account access, Info-pannes included. OpenData mode: use the public peak data, no login required. Info-pannes mode: follow the outages at an address, no login required.

account.title: Portal Mode - Account Login
account.description: Enter your Hydro-Québec credentials. The portal may ask for a one-time e-mail code.

data_description.contract_name: A friendly name for this contract (e.g., 'Home', 'Cottage')

data_description.contract: Select the contract you want to add to Home Assistant

calendar.title: Calendar Integration (Optional)
calendar.description: Automatically create calendar events for critical peak periods for {contract_name}. Events will use standardized French titles for blueprint compatibility.

data_description.calendar_entity_id: Select a calendar entity to create peak events. Leave empty to skip calendar integration.

calendar_opendata.title: Calendar Integration (Optional)
calendar_opendata.description: Automatically create calendar events for critical peak periods for {contract_name}. Events will use standardized French titles for blueprint compatibility.

data_description.calendar_entity_id: Select a calendar entity to create peak events. Leave empty to skip calendar integration.

import_history.title: Import Consumption History
import_history.description: Configure consumption sync for the Energy Dashboard. Enable to import hourly consumption data. If enabled, the last 30 days will be synced automatically. Maximum available history is 800 days. Set to 0 to skip additional history import. The import runs in the background and may take several minutes.

data_description.enable_consumption_sync: Enable to create consumption sensors and sync hourly data for Energy Dashboard. Disable if you don't need consumption tracking or have another integration providing this data.
data_description.history_days: Number of days to import (0-800). Set to 0 to sync only the last 30 days, or enter a value for older history. Only applies if consumption sync is enabled.

opendata.title: OpenData Mode - Select Sector
opendata.description: Configure monitoring using public data (no login required). First, select your customer sector.

data_description.sector: Select whether you are a residential or commercial customer

opendata_offer.title: OpenData Mode - Select Rate
opendata_offer.description: Select your electricity rate plan for {sector} customers. Available options are fetched from Hydro-Québec's public API.

data_description.contract_name: A friendly name for this configuration (e.g., 'Home', 'Cottage')
data_description.rate_selection: Select your electricity rate plan from available options

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Portal Account
reconfigure.description: Update the Hydro-Québec credentials, then select the contract again (currently {contract_id}). The contract name, entities and history are kept.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password

reconfigure_contract.title: Select Contract
reconfigure_contract.description: Choose the contract this entry should follow (currently {contract_id}). Existing entities are moved to the selected contract.

data_description.contract: Pick the new contract number if Hydro-Québec changed it

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Portal Account
reauth_confirm.description: Hydro-Québec refused the password for {username}, or the portal session expired. Enter the password; if the portal asks for a verification code, the next step will request it. If the portal asked you to change it, set the new password on the Hydro-Québec website first, then enter it here.

mfa.title: E-mail Verification
mfa.description: Hydro-Québec sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it below. Leave the field empty to receive a new code. The session length depends on the login client (Options → Advanced): 90 days renewed automatically with the mobile app, 24 hours with the web portal.

data_description.mfa_code: The one-time code from the Hydro-Québec e-mail

info_pannes.title: Search by address
info_pannes.description: The integration looks up the consumption location at this address with Hydro-Québec. The address is not stored.

info_pannes_choix.title: Choose the consumption location
info_pannes_choix.description: Several consumption locations match this address.

error.no_contracts: No contracts found for this account
error.portal_unavailable: Hydro-Québec portal is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
error.portal_maintenance: Hydro-Québec portal is under maintenance (Error 500). Please try again in a few hours.
error.invalid_mfa_code: The verification code was refused. Check the code and try again.
error.mfa_expired: The verification step expired. Try again to receive a new code.
error.mfa_code_resent: A new verification code was sent to {email}.
error.mfa_code_resend_failed: Could not request a new code automatically. Check that {email} is the right address and try again in a moment.
error.mfa_unsupported: The installed Hydro-Quebec API Wrapper does not support e-mail verification. Update it and restart Home Assistant.
error.adresse_ambigue: Several consumption locations match this address and cannot be told apart. Add the apartment number.
error.adresse_introuvable: No consumption location found at this address. Check the postal code, civic number and apartment.
error.invalid_code_postal: The postal code must be in the A1A 1A1 form

abort.reconfigure_portal_only: Only Portal Mode entries can be reconfigured
abort.missing_contract: The selected contract was not found
abort.lieu_suivi_par_contrat: This location is already followed by a contract set up in Portal mode, which includes its Info-pannes data.
abort.lieu_deja_configure: This consumption location is already followed by Info-pannes

data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch data from Hydro-Québec (30-600 seconds)
data_description.preheat_duration_minutes: Duration before critical peak events to trigger pre-heating (0-240 minutes)
data_description.enable_consumption_sync: Enable to sync hourly consumption data for the energy dashboard. Requires integration reload to take effect.
data_description.calendar_entity_id: Calendar entity for peak events (DPC/DCPC rates only). Leave empty to disable.
data_description.enable_info_pannes: Adds the Info-pannes entities of the contract's consumption location, updated every 3 minutes. When off, the entities are removed and Info-pannes is no longer queried.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: How the integration signs in to the Hydro-Québec portal.

data_description.auth_client: Switching client reloads the integration and asks for a new e-mail verification code.

options.mobile: Mobile app (recommended): session renewed automatically (90 days)
options.web: Web portal: new verification code every day (24 hours)

options.info_pannes: Info-pannes (outages at an address, no login required)

state.travaux_en_cours: Work in progress on the power grid
state.travaux_par_priorite: Work proceeding in order of priority

state.contact_accidentel: Accidental contact with the power system
state.entretien_urgent: Emergency work on the power system
state.usure_materiel: Material wear and tear or breakdown

unexpected_payload.message: The Hydro-Québec API returned a response that could not be read

api_status.message: The Hydro-Québec API answered with status {status}

api_server_error.message: The Hydro-Québec API answered with status {status} after {attempts} attempts

api_timeout.message: The Hydro-Québec API did not answer after {attempts} attempts

connection_error.message: Unable to reach the Hydro-Québec API after {attempts} attempts

invalid_response.message: The Hydro-Québec API returned an unexpected response format

api_schema_changed.title: Hydro-Québec API structure changed
api_schema_changed.description: The integration received an unexpected response from the Hydro-Québec API (missing fields: {missing_fields}). The integration may need to be updated to match a new API structure. If this persists after updating, please report it on the issue tracker.

api_invalid_response.title: Unexpected Hydro-Québec API response
api_invalid_response.description: The integration received a response from the Hydro-Québec API in an unexpected format (a list of locations was expected). Entities stay unavailable until a valid response arrives. If this persists, check whether an integration update is available and report it on the issue tracker.
